reference.title: Scenario 2 — <ul> list with bold term and separator pattern
reference.shortdesc: Scenario 2 — <ul> list with bold term and separator pattern Consider a concept section

section.p: Consider a concept section titled "Connection Modes" where the author has used a <ul> list where each <li> begins with a <strong> term followed by a — separator and definition text.

entry.codeblock:
Connection Modes

The device supports the following connection modes.

  • Wired — Uses an Ethernet cable to connect the device directly to the network switch.
  • Wireless — Connects the device using the built-in Wi-Fi adapter.
  • Bluetooth — Pairs the device with a host computer for short-range data transfer.

Connection Modes

The device supports the following connection modes.

Wired

Uses an Ethernet cable to connect the device directly to the network switch.

Wireless

Connects the device using the built-in Wi-Fi adapter.

Bluetooth

Pairs the device with a host computer for short-range data transfer.

section.p: Result: The converter detects the bold-term pattern and maps the <ul> to a DITA <dl>. Each <li> becomes a <dlentry>, the <strong> text maps to <dt>, and the remaining text maps to <dd>. The separator character is stripped.
